verdict.rationale: EDD's published file-and-pay page says payroll tax payments can be made with "No enrollment is necessary to use this service," which is a documented keyless entry path. The other core flows (registering an employer account, filing returns, reporting changes) run through e-Services for Business, which requires enrollment with email verification and multi-factor setup. missing for 10: a documented no-account path for employer registration or filing, explicit documentation of a file-number (account-number) entry method, hands-on confirmation of the keyless payment flow (the portal host returned 403 to probing).
